title: Good Ol' Cap
wikitext: {{Infobox mousehat |name = Good Ol' Cap |image = Good Ol' Cap.png |achievement = Greenhorn |ad = Earn {{Price|15000}} |price = {{Price|1000}} }} The '''Good Ol' Cap''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be purchased from the [[Abandoned House]] for {{Price|1000}} after earning the "Greenhorn" [[Achievements|Achievement]] (earn {{Price|15000}}). It can also be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. There is a ≈2% chance to receive the gender-neutral outfit with the Good Ol' Cap. ==Notes== * The Good Ol' Cap outfit also includes the [[File:Shirt266.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Brown Overalls]] and [[File:Farmer Pants.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Farmer Pants]] (dyed RGB value 130,78,1). ==References== Male players have 47 possible outfits (1/47 ≈ 2.13%), while female players have 48 possible ones (1/48 ≈ 2.08%). See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb.
